name: gradescope-archiver-extension
description: Chrome extension to archive Gradescope courses to GitHub

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cd extension && zip -r ../dist/gradescope-archiver.zip . && echo 'Build complete → dist/gradescope-archiver.zip'
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist 2>nul & mkdir dist & cd extension & powershell Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../dist/gradescope-archiver.zip
